MESSAGE: I'll ask one time: who are you? and how do you know my name?
You know, that's a neat trick you got there.
Almost reminds me of a couple people.
A creepypasta and a sheriff to be specific.

targets.name: Silver Fox (God of Destruction and the Multiverse)

MESSAGE: You've come across me now, have you?
I have to say, I admire the fact that you can stand, no fear.
How do you stand unflinching, Ourple?
Many would be terrified of me.
You don't think I know you?
I've been watching you for ages.
You think I don't know it all?
I know it all, seen it all, and know how to counteract it.
Do you really want a fight?
Do you really think you can win?
You think you own this realm?
No... Welcome to the Void Between Worlds.
You ticked off the wrong god today.
Now what slapstick logic is next?
